datasets.name: CreditAnalysDataSet
datasets.sql:
SELECT p.boorowerid, p.id creditid, p.branchid, p.currency, p.numberofcredit,f.name filname,p.creditlineamount,a.booroweraccid,nvl(cm_utils.get_gecgun(p.id,sbop.get_date),0) dueday,
       p.customertype, p.credittype, p.usid, p.personaltype,nvl(h.penaltyrest,0) PENALTYREST,(select description from cm_usergroups where id=usrgroup)usrgroup ,b.phonenumber,
       p.dateofconclusion,p.duedatefirstcontract,p.closedate,nvl(cm_utils.Get_MainPlanPayment(p.id),0) mainpay,
       nvl(h.rest,0) rest, nvl(h.interestrest,0) interestrest,nvl( h.duerest,0) duerest, nvl(h.dueinterestrest,0) dueinterestrest, v.val_name,
       (nvl(h.rest,0)+nvl(h.interestrest,0)+nvl(h.duerest,0)+nvl(h.dueinterestrest,0)+nvl(h.penaltyrest,0)) cem,
       (nvl(cm_utils.Get_MainPlanPayment(p.id),0) +nvl(h.interestrest,0)+nvl(h.duerest,0)+nvl(h.dueinterestrest,0)+nvl(h.penaltyrest,0))cempay,
       v.valute, cm_common.accountnumber_get (a.contractaccid) AS contractaccno,
(select filialid from smart.sba_objinf where sysuserid=uid) userfil,'Kredit ödənişi Müq № '||p.numberofcredit||' ('||b.name||' )' tey
  FROM smart.cm_portfolio p, cm_curr_state h, avalute v, cm_accounts a,filial_t f,cm_boorowerinfo b 
 WHERE (h.creditid = p.id)
    and (b.creditid = p.id)
   AND (v.valute = p.currency)
   AND (f.id = p.branchid)
   AND (p.boorowerid =:boorowerid)
   AND (a.creditid = p.id)
ORDER BY :orderfield

datasets.name: ReportDataSet
datasets.sql:
select 
      p.numberofcredit,
      p.dateofconclusion,
      p.closedate,
      p.purposeofcredit,
      p.creditlineamount,
      p.annualyinterestrate,
      p.annualyoverduerate,
      p.annualypenaltyrate,
      per.descripion,
      cat.description,
      crd.description,
      usrgr.description,
      val.val_name,
      plg.pledgename,
      GET_RESERVES_NAME(h.reserveid) as resrevename,
      GET_RESERVES_NAME(h.duereserveid) as dueresrevename,
      h.pledgeprice
from 
    cm_portfolio p,
    cm_persons per,
    cm_categories cat,
    cm_credittypes crd,
    cm_usergroups usrgr,
    sb_avalute val,
    cm_guarantee plg,
    cm_curr_state h
where 
    p.personaltype = per.id and    
    p.customertype = cat.id and
    p.credittype = crd.id and
    p.usrgroup = usrgr.id and
    p.currency = val.valute and
    p.id = h.creditid and
    p.id = plg.creditid and
    p.id = :CrdID
